articles.summary: Seaboard Marine is pleased to announce the expansion of our regional network with the introduction of an additional weekly sailing from Moin, Costa Rica, to Guayaquil, Ecuador, and Callao, Peru. The new Monday departure complements the company’s existing Saturday service, providing enhanced flexibility and improved scheduling options for importers and exporters throughout Central and South
articles.title: Seaboard Marine Expands Regional Service with New Weekly Monday Departures from Costa Rica to Ecuador and Peru
